source.quote: Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

tasks.reasoning:
The repo uses stripe-node 14.1.0 with apiVersion pinned to 2023-10-16. Because the version is pinned, none of the endive or dahlia breaking changes hit production today; they bite only when the SDK and API version are upgraded. This task is the single coherent upgrade to stripe-node 23 / 2026-09-30.endive, which crosses the 19 through 23 majors. Concrete edits: (1) bump the stripe package and change the apiVersion literal; (2) remove payment_method_types from checkout.sessions.create (src/trpc/index.ts:181); (3) confirm `new Stripe(...)` construction (v22); (4) re-check webhook constructEvent usage and event typing; (5) audit the subscription fields read after subscriptions.retrieve. The migration agent should check the basil-era move of current_period_end to subscription items, which is not in this change list but is crossed by the jump, plus any decimal and price fields read. Nothing forces the upgrade on a date, so urgency is medium. Deadline is the endive release date.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- stripe:2026-09-30-endive-api-version (api-version): New API major 2026-09-30.endive carries breaking changes; pin it via Stripe-Version or upgrade SDKs (node 23, python 16, go v87), effective 2026-09-30. stripe-node 23.0.0 pins 2026-09-30.endive, so bumping the SDK and changing the apiVersion literal in src/lib/stripe.ts:7 from 2023-10-16 is the same move.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "As the first version in the Endive release, `2026-09-30.endive` introduces both breaking changes and new features."
- stripe:2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout (field-removed): payment_method_types removed from Checkout Sessions create, and paymentMethodTypes option removed from Elements deferred intents (Stripe.js), effective 2026-09-30. Only applies on endive. Once the repo moves there, checkout.sessions.create in src/trpc/index.ts:181 must drop payment_method_types and rely on dynamic payment methods, so the edit belongs in this bump.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "We [removed the `payment_method_types` parameter from Checkout Sessions]"
- stripe:2026-03-25-dahlia-api-version (api-version): API major 2026-03-25.dahlia with breaking changes (Checkout ui_mode enum values, events_from on event destinations, Capabilities risk requirements, Stripe.js method removals), effective 2026-03-25. Dahlia is an intermediate API major crossed on the way from 2023-10-16 to endive. Its breaking items (ui_mode enums, events_from, Capabilities, Stripe.js) do not touch recorded call sites, and it is resolved by the same version jump.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md
  "As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features"
- stripe:node-22-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 22.0.0: Stripe is a true ES6 class (use new Stripe()), types reworked, per-request host override removed, effective 2026-04-02. Crossed by the 14.1.0 to 23 upgrade. Stripe must be built with `new Stripe()` (check src/lib/stripe.ts), types are reworked, and the per-request host override is removed.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Stripe import is now a true ES6 class. Use `new Stripe()` to create a StripeClient instead of calling it:"
- stripe:node-21-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 21.0.0: pins 2026-03-25.dahlia, drops Node 16, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, wrong webhook parsing method throws, effective 2026-03-25. Crossed by the upgrade. It pins dahlia, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, and calling the wrong webhook parsing method now throws. Verify that webhooks.constructEvent at route.ts:13 is the correct method.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "All `decimal_string` fields changed type from `string` to `Stripe.Decimal` in both request params and response objects."
- stripe:node-20-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 20.0.0: pins 2025-11-17.clover; v2 array params use indexed serialization (may break mock-server tests), effective 2025-11-18. Crossed by the upgrade. The v2 array serialization change only affects v2 APIs and mock-server tests, which the repo does not appear to use, so no extra edit is expected beyond the bump.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "This may break any unit tests that expect the latter behavior when setting up a mock server."
- stripe:node-19-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 19.0.0: pins 2025-09-30.clover; parseThinEvent renamed parseEventNotification, v2 delete returns V2DeletedObject, v2 nullable props optional; 19.x deprecated (Files API timeout bug), effective 2025-09-30. Crossed by the upgrade. The parseThinEvent rename and v2 delete and nullable changes concern v2 and thin events, which the repo does not use. Skip 19.x entirely because it is deprecated.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Rename function `StripeClient.parseThinEvent` to `StripeClient.parseEventNotification` and remove the `Stripe.ThinEvent` interface."

## stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields [Needs review]

### Change

Bumped stripe 14.1.0 to 23.0.0 and pinned apiVersion 2026-09-30.endive. The webhook now reads current_period_end from items.data[0]. The invoice.payment_succeeded branch takes the subscription id from invoice.parent.subscription_details and returns 200 if it is absent. Removed payment_method_types from checkout.sessions.create. `new Stripe()` was already in use, and the repo has no constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType, or thin-event usage. Typecheck and build pass. Added scripts/check-stripe-migration.js, which fails on the original code and passes now.

Files touched:
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`
- `scripts/check-stripe-migration.js`
- `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts`
- `src/lib/stripe.ts`
- `src/trpc/index.ts`

### Why

Stripe 23 / endive types and API moved subscription period end to items, removed invoice.subscription, and removed payment_method_types from Checkout Sessions.

> Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| stripe-migration | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- stripe-migration, added by the agent: `export DATABASE_URL='postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/db' OPENAI_API_KEY='placeholder' PINECONE_API_KEY='placeholder' PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT='placeholder' KINDE_CLIENT_ID='placeholder' KINDE_CLIENT_SECRET='placeholder' KINDE_ISSUER_URL='https://placeholder.kinde.com' KINDE_SITE_URL='http://localhost:3000' KINDE_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL='http://localhost:3000' KINDE_POST_LOGIN_REDIRECT_URL='http://localhost:3000/dashboard' UPLOADTHING_SECRET='placeholder' UPLOADTHING_APP_ID='placeholder' STRIPE_SECRET_KEY='placeholder'; node scripts/check-stripe-migration.js` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (The postinstall hook (prisma generate) did not run because install scripts were off. The typecheck needs the generated Prisma client types from @prisma/client. The build script runs it too, but tsc runs first.); it exited 0.
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (The postinstall hook did not run with install scripts off, so the Prisma client must be generated for the typecheck and build to see its types.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: DATABASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, PINECONE_API_KEY, PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT, KINDE_CLIENT_ID, KINDE_CLIENT_SECRET, KINDE_ISSUER_URL, KINDE_SITE_URL, KINDE_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL, KINDE_POST_LOGIN_REDIRECT_URL, UPLOADTHING_SECRET, UPLOADTHING_APP_ID, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- I did not run stripe_check_params or any other provider validator.
- The proof check is a static source check, not a runtime test of the webhook.
- Endive response shapes were not verified with live calls.
- The existing early return on missing session.metadata.userId runs before the invoice branch. Invoice objects usually have no such metadata, so invoice events may never reach that branch. This predates the migration and I left it alone.
- The agent wrote no test of this change and gave no reason why none can be written.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- Checkout no longer restricts payment methods to card, so customers see dynamic payment methods.
- Period end is read from the first subscription item, which assumes single-item subscriptions.
- Invoice events without a subscription reference now return 200 without updating the user.
- Align the dashboard webhook endpoint's API version to endive.
- Confirm the deploy runtime is Node >=20.

---

preparation.reasoning:
The only setup step is the Prisma client generation from prisma/schema.prisma, which postinstall would have run. It needs no live database connection, only the DATABASE_URL env var to be defined, so a placeholder value is enough. No other codegen or workspace builds are present.
The build failed while collecting page data because the OpenAI client is created at module load in /api/message and OPENAI_API_KEY is missing. A placeholder fixes that. The other placeholders (Pinecone, Kinde, UploadThing, Stripe) cover clients that are likely created at import time in the same way. The ESLint warning is not an error. prisma generate is needed because the postinstall hook was skipped.

review.summary: The SDK bump and pinned version compile, and the code adapts to the moved fields (`current_period_end` now on subscription items, invoice subscription now under `parent.subscription_details`). The removed `constructEventWithoutVerification` was never used, so the headline change needs no code. The remaining risks are things the checks cannot prove. First, webhook payload shape follows the API version set on the Stripe webhook endpoint, not the SDK's `apiVersion`. Second, removing `payment_method_types` is a product behaviour change. Third, the `?? 0` fallback silently writes a 1970 date. The stripe-migration check is a script the agent wrote to confirm its own edits, so it proves nothing at runtime. needs-review is the right grade.

concerns.issue: The invoice.payment_succeeded branch now reads `invoice.parent?.subscription_details?.subscription`. Webhook event bodies are rendered at the API version configured on the webhook endpoint in the Stripe Dashboard, not the SDK's `apiVersion`. If the endpoint is still on 2023-10-16, `parent` is absent and the handler returns 200 without updating anything. Renewals would then stop extending `stripeCurrentPeriodEnd`, and users would appear unsubscribed after one period. The endpoint version must be moved in lockstep, or the code should fall back to the legacy `invoice.subscription` field.

`(subscription.items.data[0]?.current_period_end ?? 0) * 1000` silently stores 1970-01-01 when the field is missing. `getUserSubscriptionPlan` would then treat a paying user as unsubscribed. Failing loudly or skipping the update would be safer than writing epoch 0.

Removing `payment_method_types: ["card"]` hands payment-method selection to Stripe's Dashboard settings. Checkout may then offer non-card methods, some of which do not support subscriptions or need extra handling. I could not confirm that 2026-09-30.endive removes or rejects this parameter; check the quoted CHANGELOG and the SDK's `Checkout.SessionCreateParams` types. If the parameter is still accepted, this change is not forced by the migration.

Pre-existing issue, not introduced by the diff: the early return when `session.metadata.userId` is missing also applies to invoice events. Invoice metadata does not inherit checkout session metadata unless `subscription_data.metadata` is set. The invoice branch may therefore never run, which makes the new `parent` logic untested in practice.

The bump jumps from stripe 14 to 23, skipping eight majors, and the API version moves from 2023-10-16 to 2026-09-30.endive. stripe 23 requires Node >=20. The deploy runtime (e.g. Vercel Node version) needs confirming. Response-shape changes such as `cancel_at_period_end` semantics and billing portal or checkout behaviour are only proven by types, not by live calls. I could not confirm the `2026-09-30.endive` version string beyond typecheck passing against the SDK types.
This agent-authored check only greps for the strings the agent inserted. It does not exercise a webhook or any Stripe call. Consider not committing it, or replace it with a real test.

checkFirst: Which API version the production and test webhook endpoints in the Stripe Dashboard are set to, and whether they will be upgraded to 2026-09-30.endive at deploy time.
Replay `checkout.session.completed` and `invoice.payment_succeeded` with the Stripe CLI (`stripe trigger`) against the new code and confirm the DB rows update with correct period-end dates.
Whether dropping `payment_method_types` is intended and required, and which payment methods are enabled in the Dashboard.
That the deployment runtime is Node >=20.
